html: I wonder what is the number of representatives per population? I'd assume it grew to 1 representative per 1,000,000 people? (that means 5,700+ representatives, which sounds reasonable in future numbers) or like 1 representative per 10,000,000 people (570+ which sounds more reasonable in our numbers, the future would probably not be bothered by bigger numbers though...especially when the electoral college was removed)?
